name: aca-full-time-at-the-line
summary: Twelve-month periods from October. Two workers hired 2024-06-03, hours on file from 2025-10-01. Full-time means at least 30 hours a week on average: minutes × 7 ≥ 1,800 × days. 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 is 365 days, so the line is 657,000 ÷ 7 = 93,857.14 minutes. A worked 257 minutes every day: 93,805 minutes, × 7 = 656,635 < 657,000 — not full-time (29:59 a week). B worked 258: 94,170 minutes, × 7 = 659,190 ≥ 657,000 — full-time (30:06 a week). The period running since 2026-10-01 counts 15 days so far.
